title: Attach baseline autopilot to every Agent lifecycle path
root_cause: Baseline sync lifecycle was not consistently attached to every Agent execution path.
proposed_solution: Ensure Agent execution, merge, observer, planner, and queue paths never require user manual rebase, merge, or docs/ops/runs cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement candidate contains source pattern traceability.
No business code, migration, DB write, deploy, seed, reset, cleanup, or push is performed.
Doctor and Finalize expose Evolution Center state.
User-facing instructions no longer require manual sync, rebase, merge, or runs cleanup.

title: Prevent runner-owned false quarantine and recover terminal generations
root_cause: Worktree dependency preparation and dirty-worktree classification use the same unfiltered git status surface, while no automatic generation recovery follows a runner-owned technical HOLD.
proposed_solution: Ignore runner-created dependency links during dirty classification, preserve real business diff detection, and auto-redispatch only approved generations whose HOLD evidence is entirely runner-owned technical noise.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement candidate contains source pattern traceability.
No business code, migration, DB write, deploy, seed, reset, cleanup, or push is performed.
Doctor and Finalize expose Evolution Center state.
node_modules links created by the runner never make a worktree dirty.
Real apps/api and apps/web modifications remain visible to the evidence gate.
A technical terminal generation can be recreated at most twice and never includes A6/A7.

title: Enforce Agent report schema compliance before decision
root_cause: Report schema compliance is not enforced before result parsing.
proposed_solution: Normalize and validate required report fields before parse, diagnose, decision, and task board updates.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement candidate contains source pattern traceability.
No business code, migration, DB write, deploy, seed, reset, cleanup, or push is performed.
Doctor and Finalize expose Evolution Center state.
Missing report fields are detected and normalized before next-Agent decision.

title: Harden A2/A3 routing for authorization and protected attachment
root_cause: Router keyword and fail-down policy did not fully encode Phoenix-specific signals.
proposed_solution: Add Router regression coverage for menu code, role authorization, protected preview/download, attachment ACL, and backend boundary signals.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement candidate contains source pattern traceability.
No business code, migration, DB write, deploy, seed, reset, cleanup, or push is performed.
Doctor and Finalize expose Evolution Center state.
Protected attachment and authorization requests select both A2 and A3.

title: Harden A5 data readiness routing
root_cause: Data readiness signals were not represented as mandatory A5 fail-down triggers.
proposed_solution: Keep data readiness, readiness, master data, store/company/account/role mapping as mandatory A5 Router triggers with regression fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement candidate contains source pattern traceability.
No business code, migration, DB write, deploy, seed, reset, cleanup, or push is performed.
Doctor and Finalize expose Evolution Center state.
A5 is selected whenever readiness or data preparation signals appear with relevant context.

title: Reduce queue JSON conflicts
root_cause: Mutable queue JSON is used as both write model and read model.
proposed_solution: Move toward an event-first read model and minimize mutable queue JSON writes.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement candidate contains source pattern traceability.
No business code, migration, DB write, deploy, seed, reset, cleanup, or push is performed.
Doctor and Finalize expose Evolution Center state.
Queue readers can tolerate task snapshot conflicts by deriving status from events.
